### About

Hi everyone, I'm Yuhan! I recently earned my [ScM in Biostatistics](https://publichealth.jhu.edu/academics/scm-dept-of-biostatistics) from the [Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health](https://publichealth.jhu.edu/), where I developed a strong interest in leveraging real-world evidence (RWE) and clinical trial data to address complex public health and biomedical challenges.

I hold a B.S. in [Honors Mathematics](https://lsa.umich.edu/math/undergraduates/major-and-minor-programs/honors-mathematics.html) from the [University of Michigan](https://umich.edu/), where I built a solid foundation in quantitative analysis. After graduation, I worked as a statistical programmer at [Acumen, LLC](https://www.acumenllc.com/), focusing on health policy research. This experience sparked my passion for data-driven public health work.

I further expanded my skill set as a summer healthcare analyst intern at [Analysis Group](https://www.analysisgroup.com/), where I conducted statistical analyses using claims, survey, and electronic health records (EHR) data. Most recently, I worked as a graduate research assistant at the [Johns Hopkins School of Medicine](https://www.hopkinsmedicine.org/), contributing to oncology survival analysis projects.

Outside of work and academics, I enjoy walking in nature, listening to music, and rewatching episodes of *Friends*.
